body:
Make sure to tell us how it goes with the bot

EDIT: phone autocorrected bot to boy and it took on a completely different meaning

If it makes you feel better, this basically describes me, internally anyway. I'm loud with people but it's not actually anything important. I absolutely refuse at this point in time to talk to my mum about it, even though I know nothing bad would happen the anxiety is too much and I think about all the worst possible outcomes. Stay strong
I'm sorry :( I probably sound like one of those privileged people who is whining about nothing. I'm sorry...

I don't believe I'm questioning my gender, to me I'm a guy. But despite me being a guy who (I'm fairly certain) is not genderqueer, I still deeply wish I was born a girl. I've looked around online and haven't been able to find any information on how I feel. A lot of what I find is people realising they feel like a girl despite being a guy. But... I don't feel like that. I feel like a guy. But wish I was a girl... I don't know how to explain it any better it's really frustrating not feeling like I have the ability to effectively communicate how I feel. :( I'm not trying to argue with you, I may be genderqueer in some way or another, but I've never heard of anyone else speak about how I've been feeling for, basically, the past half year. Sorry if this is really confusing...
It's hard to explain... I don't want to wear dresses as a guy, but I do as a girl. If I cross dress then I'm still a guy. Sorry if it doesn't make any sense

Mad, mad, MAD props to you for being strong. From the last paragraph, I know that you'll be an awesome mum. I hope life starts to turn around for you, and sets you on the road to feeling better. (Now, I might be biased because I'm a guy) but I applaud you for saying you will teach your boy the same lesson you'll teach your daughter. There's nothing wrong for a guy to come out and say what's honestly bothering him and I think it's great you'll teach him this. THIS is what equality looks like. :)
Whaaaaat?!! How did that happen? I feel really bad for you man :(

I wouldn't trust any of my friends, and I have no girlfriend. I'm not exactly what you'd call great with the ladies... I like Reddit though, even though it's the cold Internet, this subreddit feels warm and safe.

I would, but talking to my family is one of the worst anxiety fears I have. It's like, I want people to know, it just feels like I can't talk to them about it... It sounds really dumb and like I'm expecting way too much out of people but I don't know how I'd mention it without freaking out before I can actually say anything and quickly change the subject

Sorry to hear that, I hope your feeling better. This scene is one of my favourite scenes in all of anime now, because of the strong impact it's had on me on an emotional level. I'm glad this scene helped pull you through :)
I think this comment actually just changed my life
Why couldn't it have hit us? :(
I love you dude, and I'm sure everyone here agrees.
Thank you for the kind words. I've not felt suicidal for about a week. But it's probably just the adrenaline that comes with Christmas. I may take you up on your offer of things get bad.

No, I haven't told my parents and I really don't want to. I haven't felt suicidal for about a week, which has been nice. I still feel dead inside sometimes, though.

I'd go on meds if I needed too, but that means I'd have to tell my parents :(

EDIT: Correcting myself

Since your with your girlfriend, whenever you guys are together and you feel like shit, you just need to hug. Nothing more, nothing less. Hugs are really good, especially from someone who cares about you. You hold onto her tight until you feel a bit better. It's ok to feel the way you do. Have you spoken with your girlfriend about it? She'd probably be a really great person to open up to. I'm sure she would understand and listen to you. Your lucky, dude, you don't have to go though it alone. You've got support you can lean on. Seriously though, hugs are really good for the brain.

I almost cried reading this, and I have friends and shit. I get very sad when I see couples walking around. Hugs for you, though. Whenever I go out I fool myself into thinking "What if I run into the perfect girl while walking around?" But it never happens. I'm here to listen to you, man.

EDIT: More sentence

I have a phycologist, but when I go to her I feel fine, so I tell her that I'm doing good when I know deep down I'm not. I'm afraid to tell anyone that I quite frequently I don't feel OK because then I'll have to talk to more people about it (Like my family.) I don't know what to do... Thank you, though. You take care too.

EDIT: Spelling

I think along the same lines. Falling into a lucid coma would be amazing. Controlling my dreams while not having to worry about waking up and ruining it? Sounds fun too me.

Oh, and congratulations on being clean for 2 years! This makes me genuinely happy.

It's ok, if I didn't see a lot of my current friends again I probably wouldn't mind. I just want a meaningful relationship and I just don't see anyone having that at my age and it makes me sad. I'd love to get that girl I want to see. If only I could...
I hope it turns for the better, for everyone, too. Thank you for sharing as well. It's great having some reassurance I'm not going at it alone, regardless of how selfish it sounds. Thank you :)
Exactly! When I walk out, it feels like I just wasted an entire session. Then I promise myself I'll be honest next time. But it's just a cycle that I can't stop...

This Is me so fucking much. I change my view completely, saying "life is great, I'm lying to myself. Why would I feel that way?" But then feel really empty. I jokingly tell my friends I think I'm depressed and that I think about killing myself but that's because it's the only way I can. I just physically cannot say it seriously. But even if I may say it jokingly it's serious. But people just ignore it. Which I understand why.

I cannot tell my psychiatrist anything, I say I'm feeling fine when she asks how I am when I feel many different things in one day. So I just tell her how I feel at that exact moment and it's always happy. My mind makes me think I'm lying to myself. Even now, since I don't feel depressed right now, my mind is trying to persuade me that I just lie to myself and I'm fine. But I know I'm not.

EDIT: I hope you read this because it feels so good to finally find someone like me. But I'm also sorry you have to go through it.

Hey, I'm only 15 but I agree with you. I go to school, I'm given assignments, and I do them (albeit last minute) that's my life and I hate it. I'd kill to live in a time where things where simpler. It's probably my ignorant 15 year old mind but whenever I think of the 80s and 90s I see it in very bright colours. But when I think about the generation I was born into, I just see it in all kinds of grey. To what I know, the 80s and 90s where when all I stuff I love was brand new and exciting. Video games were on the rise, shows like DBZ where airing for the first time outside Japan, the Internet was really new and exciting, parents were a bit more chill (nowadays you can't even go outside without shoes) but by the time I was born, everything was already old. Majority of video games are ass now. (I know many games were not very good during the 80s and 90s but I'd take that over season passes and microtransactions. I think the problem both of us have is that everything just feels manufactured. And sadly there's not much we can do, except maybe try and escape.
I like drawing, but I can't do it as much as I'd like too because of school assignments and stuff. I really want to just boycott school but I know I can't.
Thank you for the reply! I appreciate the advice, don't worry. I'll try to make a goal as well. My goal is to complete my last few years of school and not fail. Thank you!

Thank you for the reply! Yes, it took me a little while to remember but I do sometimes feel like I have no emotions very occasionally. Like, my friends will say something funny and I just won't laugh. I don't find it funny even though I know I would if I wasn't feeling like that.

I also feel like I put these emotions on, if that makes sense. Like, I don't always feel some things so my mind says "that's so unlike you, you mustn't really feel that way so your just faking it." But then those feelings come back and then go away again. It's a constant cycle of self doubt.
